bullets.title: Ubiquinol QH- Absorb
bullets.note:
:
For the last several months, I have been cycling on and off of creatine
monohydrate and ubiquinol (think of it as a more bio-available CoQ10). The
catalyst was preliminary data that suggests this combo might help with
mitochondrial “rehab”—so to speak—after Lyme disease and associated
antibiotics. Perhaps more broadly appealing, in some studies
([example](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wFF&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=Y&)),
creatine appears to have a neuroprotective effect in animal models of
Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and other age-related forms of
cognitive decline. This is all tentative, and I’m no MD, so if you’re an
expert, I’d love to [hear your thoughts via Twitter
(@tferriss)](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wFv&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=E&).
Please use #creatubiq so I can find you.

bullets.title: Thoughts on Gender and Radical Candor
bullets.note:
There is a lot of fuzzy and unhelpful argumentation around "gender
equality." This is the first great piece I've read, written by Kim Scott. It
also explains why most of my smart male friends have opted out of the gender
conversation entirely (e.g., lopsided risk-benefit ratio). This article points
out some under-discussed facets of this entire discussion.
